rejected.title: a beam of light crossing stretching space: Macro view focusing purely on the space expanding between objects

rejected.reason: Consists only of ambiguous abstract shapes and textures with no recognizable objects.

rejected.title: a beam of light crossing stretching space: Deep zoom into the stretching cosmic fabric increasing distance
rejected.seen: An abstract black background showing a bright white and red explosion on the left side with a thick horizontal white beam extending to the left and a thin red horizontal beam extending across to the right.
rejected.reason: It is an abstract composition of lines and a blast rather than a clear depiction of the cosmic fabric.

rejected.title: a beam of light crossing stretching space: Final pull back out to the wide cosmic landscape

rejected.reason: The silhouette of a person and abstract lines do not clearly convey a wide cosmic landscape.

rejected.reason: Resembles a logo or abstract badge rather than a clear close-up of a photon moving through space.
